Gaza Ceasefire Stalled a Year After US-Brokered Deal, NGOs Say

A year after a US-brokered ceasefire was intended to end the war in Gaza, progress has stalled, with more than 100 NGOs stating the ceasefire "exists in name only." While a ceasefire was promised, Palestinians report that the past 12 months have been characterized by a lack of substantive peace.
